notes:
Inbound from small product team building an internal knowledge assistant and developer docs search. Signed up self-serve (free credits) 2026-03-05, experimenting w/ embeddings + retrieval.
- Primary ask: quickstart examples and adapters for LangChain and LlamaIndex (they use both in different microservices). Also asked about a Vercel AI SDK example for edge-hosted frontend that calls Redwood hosted API.
- Quote from AE call (03/09): "We want something we can drop into our Next.js app today, then wire a server-side embeddings index later. Cost will matter once traffic ramps."
- Tech stack: Next.js (Vercel), Python backend (FastAPI), small Postgres for metadata, use Pinecone currently for vector storage but open to in-hosted caching.
- Latency target: 200-400ms for 95th pct for doc-search queries; throughput low now (10-50 qps) but expect bursty growth.
- Model prefs: prefer open LLaMA-style variants; interested in quantized options to save cost. Wants explicit examples for model selection + temp/top_p for chat and for embedding consistency across services.
- Security/compliance: SMB, but asked for audit logs and token rotation notes. No enterprise SSO yet.
- Value props they care about: predictable token pricing, simple SDK, plug-and-play LangChain connector, Vercel frontend example.
- Internal champions: Product lead (Aisha Martinez) and backend eng lead (Tom Becker).
- Summary of ask: 1) LangChain example repo showing Redwood hosted_api LLM + embeddings flow, 2) LlamaIndex notebook migration snippet (python), 3) Vercel Next.js example calling Redwood via serverless edge function with streaming response demo, 4) short doc on costs (batching + caching tips) for small teams.
